channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kyle Anderson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kyle Anderson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Rudy Gobert on Kyle Anderson:

“We’ve been through ups and downs, collectively and individually. That’s someone that I care about. As a team, I think everyone in this locker room has a lot of respect for Kyle. When things get hard, those moments matter.”

Rudy Gobert on Kyle Anderson, Mar 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Andrew Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Pat Riley on Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell and Andrew Wiggins:

“They are now officially part of what we do believe in, which is our culture here with the Heat. And we believe they are perfect players to be part of that. I think they’ll show it.”

Pat Riley on Andrew Wiggins, Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell, Feb 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Joe Ingles on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Ingles said of the Timberwolves.

“A part of it [was] having the interest for more than just: Kyle Anderson leaves and hey you can help us. Last year, they went pretty hard as well and we decided Orlando. Playing with Mike again will be awesome, obviously I know Rudy, and then helping these other guys to keep getting better.”

Joe Ingles on Kyle Anderson, Jul 4, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chris Finch on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Chris Finch on Kyle Anderson (out with a knee sprain):

“I don't know. It's, I would say, more day to day. I don't think it's super long, but you never know how these things respond over 48 hours.”

Chris Finch on Kyle Anderson, Feb 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Rudy Gobert on the impact the scuffle with he and Kyle Anderson had on their relationship:

“Istill love Kyle. He’s still my brother. I tell people, sometimes you fight with your family. Sometimes you fight with people that you have a lot of love and respect for. It’s life.”

Rudy Gobert on Kyle Anderson, Apr 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns on Kyle Anderson (16p, 6a, 3st, +13):

“I think he holds a lot of weight on our team and in our locker room. He’s a voice that everyone loves to listen to and we respect him tremendously, his pedigree of winning.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Kyle Anderson, Nov 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Kyle Anderson:

“He's not super talented...yet he's a hell of a player, a guy that anybody would love to have on their team. He's a special teammate,he plays smarter than most everybody else on the court, and those are great attributes. He is a special kid.”

Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson, Feb 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Dejounte on facing former teammate Kyle Anderson:

“That’s my guy. But on the floor, not my friend... I’m happy for Kyle. That’s somebody I connected with from our old life. But you got to be ready to go, no friendly stuff. Afterward, we can joke around.”

Dejounte Murray on Kyle Anderson, May 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Rudy Gay on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Rudy Gay on Kyle Anderson:

“Every year he’s added something to his game. He’s starting to shoot the ball well. Defensively, he is tough. He has long arms, he pokes at the ball, keeps you off guard. He is definitely a big part of the success they have had this past year.”

Rudy Gay on Kyle Anderson, May 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Kyle Anderson:

“He is such a pure basketball player. He has his own style – everybody calls him ‘Slo Mo.’ But he gets it done. He executes offensively, understands his role on defense, has good long arms & great hands. He rebounds. Just an all-around really good player.”

Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson, Feb 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
David Cobb:J.B. Bickerstaff on Kyle Anderson's shoulder issue:

“I don't want to anticipate anything until the experts speak on it. My college career fell short of M.D.”

JB Bickerstaff on Kyle Anderson, Feb 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @DavidWCobb.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on missing Kyle Anderson:

“He’s a wonderful young man. Good basketball player, very versatile. But a really good guy, great teammate. He was wonderful.”

Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson, Nov 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Garrett Temple, Shelvin Mack, Kyle Anderson
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff:

“We’re going to be a completely different team than you guys saw at the end of last season. Our front office and ownership group have done a great job bringing in different players with different skill sets that kind of fit the theme and the direction that we’re heading in. We’re not as young as we used to be. We’ve brought in some proven, veteran guys like Kyle Anderson, Garrett Temple, Shelvin Mack, those type of guys, who can accentuate what Marc can do.”

JB Bickerstaff on Garrett Temple, Shelvin Mack, Kyle Anderson, Sep 12, 2018. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Pop on Kyle Anderson:

“When Kawhi does come back, I’ve got some figuring out to do. (Anderson) should still be on the court,somehow or another.”

Gregg Popovich on Kyle Anderson, Nov 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.
